lines.text: Many learners say: I am not understand.
Do not! I do not understand.

native.tip: 동사 앞 부정은 do not! “I do not understand”예요.
native.caption: “I am not understand”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 일반동사를 부정할 때는 am not이 아니라 do not을 써요. “I do not understand”가 맞아요. Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Make a verb negative with do not. Say “I do not understand”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am not understand”? 😅 For a normal verb, the negative is “do not”, not “am not”. “I do not understand” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
